name: bitwarden
notes: Bitwarden's web vault, the open-source build (apps/web), the app the Angular team reportedly tested ngp on most. Nx monorepo with npm workspaces; the vault imports about 70 path aliases into libs/. Built with webpack and @ngtools/webpack, not the Angular CLI: its angular.json only serves Storybook, so the ng build reference (R) skips it.
patchNotes: The app is on Angular 21 and TypeScript 5.9; the patch is the migration to Angular 22 and TypeScript 6 and nothing else. Angular 22: CdkStep and CdkStepper constructors take no arguments; DialogConfig.closeOnNavigation also accepts strings; NG1054 rejects an @Output named like a model()'s own change output (toggledChange), so the duplicate is dropped. TypeScript 6: baseUrl is deprecated (TS5101) and every path alias is already relative to the tsconfig, so it goes; esModuleInterop is on by default, so `import * as JSZip` becomes a default import; types default to [], so apps/web/tsconfig.build.json stops pulling in the connectors' Jest specs.
installNotes: --ignore-scripts skips Electron's binary download, the desktop app's Rust build and husky, none of which the web vault's compile needs. The root package.json has no install scripts of its own.
